_comment_GlobalConfig: GlobalConfig:Path and Observability:LogFile:Directory are machine-specific — set GlobalConfig:Path in your own gitignored appsettings.Local.json (see appsettings.Local.json.example), and put Observability:LogFile:Directory inside your globalconfig.json alongside the other per-machine values. ConnectionStrings:WishlistDb/Mongo:ConnectionString/Redis:ConnectionString also moved into globalconfig.json — see appsettings.json's _comment_Path.
